note: Canonical spine. Episode titles here are the primary keys for every data file in the project. Author with plain apostrophes; the runtime normalises typographic ones.

movements.name: The Telemachy
movements.note: A house without its master, and a son sent to look for news of him.

movements.name: The Return Begins
movements.note: Odysseus released from Calypso, wrecked, and taken in by a court that asks no questions until it does.

movements.name: The Wanderings
movements.range: One night's telling - ten years of sea
movements.note: The apologoi: Odysseus narrates his own past in Alcinous' hall, and is the only witness to it.

movements.name: Ithaca in Disguise
movements.range: Days 35-38 - the farm, the town, the hall
movements.note: Home reached and not declared: the poem's longest movement is a test of a household by a man pretending to be nobody.

movements.name: The Reckoning
movements.note: Omens, the bow, and the killing floor.

movements.name: The Peace
movements.note: The bed, the orchard, the dead retelling the story, and a war stopped in its first minute.

spine.title: The Assembly
spine.lens: A son learns that speech is an instrument

Antinous and the web of Laertes

spine.setting: The beach and palace of Nestor at Pylos

spine.title: The Washing at the River

The ball, the cry, and the waking

spine.title: The Bronze Threshold

spine.setting: The palace, garden, and hearth of Alcinous
episodes: The mist, and the girl with the pitcher
The bronze walls and the garden

spine.title: The Singer and the Games

The wooden horse, and the weeping simile

episodes: Moly, and the sword at the witch's throat
Circe's sailing directions to the dead

spine.title: The Dead
spine.lens: The only place in the poem where the future is stated plainly
spine.date: Told on the night of Day 34 - at the edge of Ocean
spine.setting: The grove of Persephone at the world's edge
episodes: Anticleia, and the arms that close on nothing

spine.title: The Cattle of the Sun
spine.lens: Everything he was warned about, in order

spine.setting: Aeaea, the Sirens' meadow, the strait, and Thrinacia

The wreck and the lone survivor

spine.title: The Landing

He will come within this month

spine.lens: Two returns converging on one hut

spine.setting: Sparta, Pherae, Pylos, and the eastern shore of Ithaca
episodes: Menelaus' gifts and the eagle omen

spine.lens: The first recognition, and the first conspiracy

episodes: The dogs that do not bark

spine.date: Day 38 - the road to town, and the evening meal
spine.setting: The steading, the spring of Ithacus, and the hall

spine.title: The Fight in the Doorway
spine.lens: Two beggars, and one of them owns the house
spine.date: Day 38, evening - the hall
spine.setting: The doorway and hall of Odysseus

spine.title: The Scar
spine.lens: Recognition arrives from below, by touch, and is silenced

spine.setting: The hall by firelight, and Penelope's chair beside it
episodes: The arms carried out by torchlight
I entertained him twenty years ago
The oath, and the promise of the month
The geese, and the gates of horn and ivory

spine.title: The Last Night

spine.setting: The porch, the hall, and the courtyard of Odysseus

episodes: The secret of the olive-tree bed
The night lengthened, and the tale told over
Out to the farm at dawn

spine.title: The Peace
